notes:
Lowercase -> NFD -> drop combining marks -> match [a-z0-9]+. One module-level regex, no state.

Gate seen red first: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on lib/analyze.mjs, then 1/7 red (the structural
"only tokenizer" test) until search.mjs existed. Both mutants in bench/mutate.mjs — removing the
diacritic fold, and splitting on spaces instead of alphanumeric runs — are caught.

Deliberately NOT done: stemming and stop-word removal. The corpus is synthetic and
language-neutral, so both are guesses about a language we cannot read; a stop-word list in
particular would silently delete query terms the judge may be scoring on. If you ever add one,
the analyzer is also the query path, so regenerate bench/queries.json and re-run bench/sweep.mjs.
